attachments.declaredMeaning: intended seat (decision 8), exactly kick.footboard into kick.heel: (1) every footboard vertex below the heel top plane lies inside the heel plan outline; (2) the board crosses the heel boundary only through the heel top face, never a side, the back or the toe-side face; (3) the greatest depth below the top plane is at most maxDepthM and at most half the board thickness measured between the two parallel board faces, and the exposed upper heel-end corners stand at least minProudM above the heel top; (4) no footboard vertex is below the heel underside. Checked over ALL footboard vertices and source edges, separately from support height. Not a same-row overlap allowance

crossings.scope: segments against closed convex receiver, including touches; not a general triangle/solid collision audit

geometry.scope: exact kick footboard/heel pair, all source edges and below-top vertices; not floor support or a cylindrical hinge rule

attachments.declaredMeaning: artist intent (hi-hat repair): the 12-sided hinge barrel is a knuckle seated in the base plate, exactly hihat.hinge into hihat.base. (1) Exactly seatedVertices lie below the plane of the base top cap; every other barrel vertex is at least minUnseatedAboveTopM above it. (2) seatDepthM is the greatest perpendicular distance of a barrel vertex below that plane (not the 6 mm axis drop, not the trough width), within toleranceM, reached by exactly deepestVertices. (3) Through the top cap only: every seated vertex projects inside the top-cap outline by at least minInsideTopOutlineM, and no barrel vertex is less than minAboveBaseUndersideM above the plane of the base underside cap, so no bevel band, side or underside is crossed. (4) Level: both ring centroids (the axis ends) are axisHeightAboveTopM above the top-cap plane, within toleranceM (axis height = radius - seat depth). (5) Designed clearance, not a defect: no barrel vertex is closer than minClearanceToHeelM to the hihat.heel box (vertex-to-solid distance). Not a same-row overlap allowance

crossings.scope: segments against closed convex receiver, including touches; not a general triangle/solid collision audit

geometry.scope: criterion A: exact barrel/base pair; vertex-to-heel clearance is not a full solid-pair distance

attachments.declaredMeaning: author intent for the hi-hat heel hinge: the footboard pivots on the 12-sided hinge barrel (itself seated in the base, criterion hihat.hinge_in_base). (1) The two heel-axis vertices of the board underside lie on the barrel axis (the line through the two ring centroids) within axisToleranceM, axially between the end discs; (2) every footboard vertex that is axially between the end discs and radially within the barrel vertex radius lies inside the exact 12-gon barrel solid, so the board heel-end face is wholly inside the barrel; (3) the board is wider (104 mm) than the barrel (90 mm): its rounded heel corners pass out through the end discs, and no footboard vertex lies axially more than maxCornerOverhangM (the authored width difference, not a tolerance) beyond an end disc; (4) no footboard vertex is below the plane of the receiving base top face. A cylindrical capture, not the kick heel planar seat

geometry.scope: criterion B: board/barrel capture only; criterion A independently establishes mounting

attachments.declaredMeaning: artist intent (hi-hat repair): the footboard toe rests on the front lip of the sensor housing and does not enter it, exactly hihat.footboard onto hihat.housing. Clearance = signed perpendicular distance of a housing vertex from the plane of the board underside face, positive on that face's outward (lower) side. (1) No intersection: every housing vertex has clearance >= minClearanceM (both solids are convex and the board lies wholly on the inner side of its own underside plane, so that plane separates them). (2) Rest: the two lip vertices have clearance gapM within toleranceM, and every other housing vertex has more clearance than both. (3) Under the board: the feet of the perpendiculars from the lip vertices fall inside the underside face outline by at least minLipInsideBoardOutlineM. Reported only (not criteria): the overhang beyond the lip and the toe-tip height above the housing top. No overlap allowance is needed

geometry.scope: criterion C: exact board/housing pair; convex-plane separation covers all vertices/edges/faces; no overlap exemption

ctl.slab.contact.reason: slab ends hidden inside the cheeks; underside corners above the stand arms (never seen from the planned eyes); back-top corner covered by the panel. The exposed top-front edge is bevelled (casing)

ctl.panel.contact.reason: bottom corners rest on the slab; ends meet the cheek inner faces. Front-top and back-top edges are bevelled

ctl.bays.contact.reason: bottom corners rest on the slab; ends meet the cheeks and the outer keys; back meets the panel wall. Top-front bevelled

ctl.cheeks.contact.reason: inner face perimeter meets the slab, panel and bays; bottom profile corners at the underside on the stand arms; and (v04 decision 4) the eight bevel-band mitre edges at the two unbevelled 90-degree underside corners of each cheek (4 at 75.5 and 4 at 41.4 degrees, all within 2.2 mm of the cheek underside, facing down onto the stand arms). Outer face perimeter, back-top corner and (v04 decision 3) the cheek nose are bevelled (casing); no exposed cheek edge is in this set (author_declaration asserts it)

granted.thin_plates.reason: thin plates: kick pedal base plate (6 mm), kick and hi-hat footboards (8 mm, rounded in plan), module holder plate (6.5 mm), two wheel slots (2 mm), display bezel (9 mm). Under the 12 mm floor; black or black metal

granted.controller_wheels.reason: two pitch/mod wheels, about 40 mm, dark rubber, recessed in slots

ctl.panel_pads.reason: panel pads (C13), incl. their 2-step plan corners

ctl.glow.reason: lib_glow display face (rests on the bezel) and four pad-column indicator strips (I1 inlays: seated 1.0 mm into ctl.panel, 2.5 mm proud)

keys.white.reason: other white-key edges (C13); each white key front-top lip is bevelled (white_key_lip, H1)

granted.round_member_ends.reason: round-member ends: stand tube, rubber-end and pivot-bolt ends; rack tube, foot, stub and boom ends; pad mount-arm ends; cymbal rod, felt and tilter rims; kick posts, spurs (v04: arm ends and the dark rubber spur feet), spring, shaft, chain and cam; stool; throne; module mount-arm ends; snake and cable end caps. Ends of round sections reduced to 5-16 sides; most butt another part

faceted_round.members.reason: lengthwise facet edges and bends of low-sided round members, flat-shaded by the 40-degree split: stand arms, feet and X tubes (8 sides), booms and mount arms (10), cymbal rods, felts, tilters and nut bodies (8), kick posts, spurs, spring, shaft and axle (8), chain (6), stool and throne legs and braces (6), module snake (8), sticks (6 sides, plus tip profile facets). Side counts follow the art direction (8-16 sides under 12 px)

stand.knob.reason: knobs (C13): the stand pivot knob, read by kind of part (5a)

sustain.base.contact.reason: underside perimeter rests on the rug; top perimeter bevelled

sustain.plate.contact.reason: underside perimeter hidden under the plate; top perimeter bevelled

pedal.hinges.reason: pedal hinges (C13): sustain hinge, hi-hat heel hinge ends, kick pedal axle ends (read by kind of part, 5a)

faceted_round.cables.reason: lengthwise facet edges of the 5-sided music cables (6-sided sustain lead), incl. the edges that exceed 80 degrees where a run is skewed at a bend, and the bend rings. These are lengthwise cable facets, not end caps

faceted_round.profiles.reason: profile facets of curved lathed surfaces (24-step seat cushions with 4-5 profile points, 12-step beater head): turns of 40-80 degrees between profile points. (v04: no cymbal edge here; the bell-to-bow turn is 39.6 degrees and smooth, and the band corners are cymbal.edge)

rug.binding_shoulder.reason: accepted sharp by name (decision 7): the outer binding shoulder at the foot of its one chamfer facet (62.3 degrees on the four straight runs, 61.5 at the twelve corner edges), 8.2 mm above the floor, on the current matte, already-chamfered 10.5 mm woven binding only. Rug size and position unchanged

rug.inner_step.reason: rug's inner binding step (C13): the 2.5 mm step from the binding top down to the field, both corners

rack.clamps.reason: clamp caps and wing bolts (C13), incl. the octagonal clamp-block plan corners

pad.shell_bottom.contact.reason: hidden edge, not an exemption (decision 6): the black shell bottom corner, 52.8 degrees, 4 mm above the shell underside, where the visible black shell facet meets the shell bottom ring. That ring faces at least 63 degrees below horizontal at every authored tilt, and every planned eye is above every pad (pads 0.44-0.85 m)

pad.rim_inner.reason: pad-rim inner corners (C13): rim inner top corner and the inner corner under the rim step; outer top corner bevelled

pad.rim_lower_outer.reason: accepted sharp by name (decision 6): the bright-metal rim lower outer corner, 71.4 degrees, where the 8.9 mm rim wall meets the 6.3 mm step under it, on the four pads. The rim outer top corner stays bevelled. The obvious fallback (a casing bevel, about 384 triangles for four pads) does not fit the 2,600 row ceiling and is not authorised: an image failure goes back to root for a bounded profile / budget decision

pad.rim_skirt.contact.reason: open end of the rim inner skirt, 0.5 mm below the mesh head top and 0.6 mm outside its edge: hidden by the head

pad.head.contact.reason: 3 mm mesh-head disc edge inside the rim, 0.3 mm clear of the inner skirt and 9.5 mm below the rim top: hidden by the rim

cymbal.edge.reason: accepted sharp by name (decision 5): both corners of the 8.9 mm outer edge band of the three authored cymbals: the 70.0-degree upper corner (bow strip into the band) and the 108.5-degree lower corner (band into the underside), radius about 0.19 m. Dark matte e-cymbal pad surface (material rule fabric, the rubber pad), source profile, scale and identity as authored. No allowance for any other profile or later geometry

cymbal.nuts.reason: cymbal wing nuts (C13): wings and nut body

kick.tower.contact.reason: bottom perimeter rests on the base frame; top perimeter and plan corners bevelled

kick.base.contact.reason: bottom perimeter rests on the rug; top perimeter and plan corners bevelled

kick.head.contact.reason: fabric head rims: front rim under the pad ring's 4 mm lip, back rim against the tower face (5c)

kick.pad_ring.open.reason: open lathe ends of the ring: the back loop is buried 2 mm in the tower face; the front loop is the inner edge of the 4 mm lip lying over the fabric head (double-sided material)

kick.pad_ring.seat.reason: pad ring back corner (53 degrees) 4 mm in front of the tower face it is seated on; the outer front corner is now bevelled (casing)

granted.small_dark_blocks.reason: kick heel block, hi-hat heel rubber, six module buttons: rubber or fabric, dark, 6-20 mm

hihat.base.contact.reason: underside perimeter rests on the rug; top perimeter bevelled

hihat.housing.contact.reason: bottom perimeter rests on the base; top perimeter and plan corners bevelled

module.knob.reason: knobs (C13): the module volume knob, read by kind of part (5a)
